name: Hikikomo Rikoko
source:
A shut-in girl addicted to online games who refuses to face the outside world. She dedicates all her time to playing games, being an extremely skilled player in the world of the FPS game “ABA”. She's a total recluse in real life, but on the internet she assumes a bright and cheerful personality similar to that of an older sister.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2018/12/30/kasutera/]official website[/url]]
